description:
Start a real SWAT+ model build (authenticated; consumes the caller's fair-use quota).
    Takes either a USGS gauge id (usgs_station) or a 12-digit HUC12 outlet (huc12_outlet).
    Returns an order_id for checking the build's status. Typical build: 20 min - 2 h. The API key
    comes from the X-SWATGenX-Api-Key header on the MCP connection or the api_key argument.
name: order_model
title: Build a SWAT+ watershed model
